{{Quote|Embrace these fates: ice and fire, claw and fang, war and ruin. They are inevitable.|A Hailstorm Brotherhood proverb|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hailstorm Brotherhood''' was a fanatical subfaction of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==History==
[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces noted the radical subgroup of the White Maw pirates when scanners detected a massive ice spire rising above the Glacial Fissure sector. Scouts investigated the sculpture and reported encounters with half-naked warriors wearing [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] furs and screaming poetry as they charged into battle.<ref name="CX" />

The Hailstorm Brotherhood represented an extreme version of "going native." Originally a murderous cult from a [[Unidentified ice planet (Hailstorm Brotherhood)|nameless ice planet]], the brotherhood became a legend when its White Maw members relocated to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], abandoning all pretenses of civilization and instead embracing the call of the wild. They are more than a tribe of survivalists, however. There is a strong spiritual aspect to the Hailstorm Brotherhood that makes them dangerously fanatical.<ref name="CX" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
If the player is Empire, only the Empire will take on the Brotherhood.<ref name="Hailstorm" /> If the player is Republic, both Republic and Empire temporarily collaborate to take down the Brotherhood.<ref name="Allied">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Allied Forces|Hoth}}</ref>
